channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump denies Iran talks, Tehran claims US ‘begging’
item.description: Trump says no talks with Tehran scheduled; Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims US 'begging' for negotiations.

item.title: Al Jazeera reports from Indonesia’s quake zone, desperate for help
item.description: Thousands are still displaced on Indonesia’s Flores Island after a 7.7-magnitude earthquake killed at least 70 people.

item.title: Democrats call for USS Lincoln probe, question US Navy’s readiness
item.description: Lawmakers question whether conditions on the aircraft carrier indicate a 'pattern' of poor planning amid the Iran war.

item.title: Why is the US ramping up Tomahawk production?
item.description: The Pentagon has contracted a defence manufacturer to increase the output of cruise missiles.

item.title: Syria opens Assad-era nuclear programme to UN probe
item.description: UN watchdog reports that it found large amounts of material at undisclosed sites in Syria.

item.title: Trump says no talks planned with Iran amid anger over Iran-Oman Hormuz deal
item.description: US president hits out as states bordering the Strait of Hormuz continue talks on managing the strategic waterway.

item.title: Israeli strike reported to kill at least six in Gaza City
item.description: The strike comes as efforts to push an agreement aimed at ending hostilities remain stalled.

item.title: Russia reports Ukrainian drone strike near Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant
item.description: Concern over the security of Europe's largest nuclear plant has been rife since Russia launched its full-scale war.

item.title: Russian missile strike kills 10 civilians in Kharkiv
item.description: A Russian missile strike on Pechenihy, in Ukraine’s Kharkiv region, killed at least 10 civilians and wounded 17 others.

item.title: The Indian activist jailed after taking on a luxury hotel plan
item.description: An activist's detention has brought under focus a larger battle over land and development around the famed Kaziranga National Park.
